base: (a) Personal estate subject to administration including its income, received and accounted for, plus gross proceeds of real estate sold; (b) separately, value of real estate not sold and non-probate property includable for federal estate tax, excluding joint and survivorship property (W. Va. Code § 44-4-12a).

schedules.capNote: May be reduced or increased by the county commission; a will may set other commissions (§ 44-4-12a(d),(f)).

schedules.who: Commission on unsold real estate and non-probate taxable property (W. Va. Code § 44-4-12a(b))
schedules.text: 1% of the value of real estate not sold and of non-probate property includable for federal estate tax (W. Va. Code § 44-4-12a(b)).
